summary: The SRTF scheduler ran 6 processes with 15 preemptions over 17 ticks, achieving an average response time of 0.6. The runtime monitor would have suggested increasing the quantum to reduce the high preemption rate.
main_reason: High preemption rate (15 preemptions in 17 ticks) caused frequent context switches, increasing response time despite SRTF's optimal burst-based scheduling.
evidence: 15 preemptions occurred in 17 ticks (0.88 preemptions per tick)
burst hints were applied (5,3,4,50,6) but no quantum was defined
suggestion: Priority scheduling would likely perform better because it uses fixed priorities and avoids the overhead of frequent preemptions, reducing context switch overhead and improving response time.
